Maybe something <@!118185622543269890> likes to implement If I had the time I would hack it in myself and start drawing a pineapple on there, haha I am currently trying to patch prysm-validator to add a flag `--graffitiendpoint="localhost:3435"` it will then listen on that port and accept POST requests to update the graffiti I can then write a tool which you can pass a picture to and it will look on the current canvas which pixels need an update and then will tell the validator to update the graffiti It should be easy to run this tool besides the validator (given that the validator supports the graffiti-update), just like eth2stats besides the beaconchain-node I was thinking of just a script path to pass, call that, and then users can make the script fetch it from a web resource if they wanted too. Might be easier to get something done quick. Anyway, your solution works too, and excited to see what the first drawing will be yeah another issue is the canvas-size :p maybe 1k x 1k is too big, given that there are only 7200 blocks a day haha would take like 138 days to fill the canvas And please ignore the TTP many games make. Family friendly stuff, even if immutable 😅 still with zooming/paning it should be usable <@203220829473996800> oooo that'd be dope I'll make a tracking issue for it, thanks! If we successfully draw a coherent picture, does that indicate the formation of a cartel? coherent picture = consensus
